property_summary: For any depositor, a successful deposit followed by CashOut of the exact post-deposit balance must either revert or leave the balance zero (never leave a positive balance with a successful call); the buggy strict inequality silently leaves the full balance untouched on a full-balance withdrawal, violating this rule.
change_summary: Replace the balance check condition `_am<=balances[msg.sender]` with a strict inequality `_am<balances[msg.sender]`, causing CashOut of exactly the full balance to revert silently.
